ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a marine food web diagram. In the lower right of the image, a fish labeled “Flat Fish” can be seen; below it are aquatic plants labeled “Aquatic Plants.” In the diagram there is a blue arrow from “Aquatic Plants” pointing upward to “Flat Fish.” Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate energy or food flowing from the eaten source to the consumer, that is, from the food to the organism that eats it. Because the arrow points from aquatic plants to flat fish, it shows that flat fish eats aquatic plants. Animals that eat plants are herbivore.
